newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: CRICKET-TIKOLO HITS 147 IN ICC TROPHY FINAL.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-TIKOLO HITS 147 IN ICC TROPHY FINAL.

text.p: Steve Tikolo smashed 147 as Kenya made 241 for seven against Bangladesh in the rain-hit final of the International Cricket Council (ICC) Trophy on Saturday.
Play was then called off for the day and will resume on Sunday. The start was delayed because of heavy rain overnight.
Tikolo's runs came from only 152 balls and he shared in 138-run fourth-wicket partnership with captain Maurice Odumbe who scored 43.
Mohammed Rafique was the most successful bowler with three for 40 in six overs.
